speaker: Enzo Maresca
quote_text:
Yeah, I think overall we play a good game. We  prepare the game in the way the game was, in  
terms of starting one way and finishing the other  way. We play first the night, demanding game,  
24 hours less than them. You know, tricky, tricky  stadium, tricky game, sunny, sunny day, the pitch  
was dry, they tried to kill, kill, kill the tempo  of the game, so it was for me was a complete game,  
but overall, as I said, I think we did enough  to win the game, we shot more than 20 times.  
And probably the only thing we miss has been the  goal, but overall, happy with the performance. No,  
the reason why is because we play Thursday night,  so not all of them, they were 100%. So the idea  
was to start in one way and to finish in the other  way, and the plan nearly worked because as you  
said, second-half, the last half an hour, probably  we create a little bit more. But I think overall  
the volume between first half and second-half has  been enough to win the game. This is a different  
opinion. I am here to try to do the best for the  club, for the players. And I work every day with  
the players so I can see them the way they are.  And to be honest, I don't know if Spurs at home  
is-- Spurs at home compared to Brentford the  way it's better or worse. For me, they are all  
complicated. You can see. And Brentford, I think,  is very clear what they try to do, how good they  
are, not only in set pieces, in transition. And  I think unless the last transition we concede,  
we control them very well. So, yeah. I think we  started the season winning away many games. We  
won away games and we struggled a little bit  at home. Now it's in the other way. I think  
to get top four, top five, or fight for title,  you need the right balance. Probably, as you said,  
in this moment, we struggle a little bit more to  win game away. But overall, in terms of numbers,  
I think we are there since we start. And  hopefully we can, from now on, we can win  
some games away. But also it's important, I  think, to continue to win the games at home.  
No, to be honest, I don't prepare. For instance,  I didn't prepare to the game thinking, guys,  
it's a long time, we don't win away, we need to  win away. No. Since we started, I always said the  
same. When you are not able to win, it's important  that you don't use, you take the point, you move  
the table. And as I said, I think also at this  stage of the season, 24 hours make the difference,  
you know, to rest energy. But this is the reason  why I'm happy with the performance, because they  
gave everything. I think so, yes, especially  at this stage of the season, but we tried  
toward that, and because, as I said, Thursday  night game was a demanding game. You know,  
we said many times that when this transition  game is demanding, physicality demanding. So  
Tottenham was more transition than compared  to today, for instance. But at this stage,  
I think 24 hours making a difference. No, if, as  you said, if there is a rule that about 72 hours,  
probably you need to respect that. But it's not  just about today or our game. It's probably every  
weekend or happen many times that there  are teams that they don't have a rest for  
72 hours and they try to adapt. At the same  time, we try to do our best. The reason why,  
first half, we start in one way and second-half,  we finish in the other way is because of that,  
and probably if we decide to start first off in  the way we finish, probably after half an hour,  
45 minutes, the team was not physically enough  good to finish the game. So we try to find  
solution like today. No, it will be very important  to get some more goals from the ones up front. But  
again, I think we are three or four scoring goals  over the Premier League. So I don't have the  
feeling that this team need to score more goals.  And also when we don't score like today, we shot  
more than 20 times. So I think the question is for  sure we want more goals from the players at front,  
even from set pieces in general. We want to score  more goals. But I don't think it's the reason why,  
I don't think it's a problem in terms of we  are top three, top four in terms of scoring  
goal. We create chances every game probably. We  struggle to create chances in one or two games,  
but the reason why was also because we play  without a nine. If you remember, the last four or  
five games ago, we struggled to create chances,  but it's also normal. Now with the Noni back,  
I think we are creating, but at the same time we  are scoring goal and hopefully you know, when you  
shot more than 20 times, hopefully next time we  can we can score. Sometimes you need to shot and  
you score. It's it's it's like this. No, it's I  think it's just it's just a game. I don't think  
it's like effort because at the end I can see  Cristo every day and he's working well. Sometimes,  
probably, he wants to give more during a game and  he struggle a little bit, but for sure I don't  
think it's a lack of, as I said, effort, exactly.  As I said, we planned the game in this way, to  
start in one way and to finish in a different way.  So we also think that probably after 45 minutes,  
one hour, the team was our team was getting better  and better and they probably, because we tried to  
keep the ball, they ran and after 45 minutes, one  hour, they could be tired. So we expect to improve  
in the second-half. And then in terms of Cristo,  I always say the same. When they work hard and  
they give everything, it's not a problem. No,  no, no, it's for sure will be very important.  
I said since day one that our duty, our target  is to bring this club where this club has to be,  
that is Champions League. And I think since  day one, since we start, we have been there,  
always top four, top five for part of the  season, we were second. So I think since day one,  
we are there and hopefully we can we can finish  there. OK, thanks guys. Thank you. Thank you.
title: Enzo Maresca post-match press conference | Brentford 0-0 Chelsea
